title: Thread/get: thread model — walk In-Reply-To and References via overview
description: Implement thread root discovery: given an article, walk In-Reply-To and References headers via the overview index to find the earliest known ancestor. Thread ID = CID of root article. Articles with no In-Reply-To: thread ID = own CID. Store thread_id in overview table as a new column. Blocked on: stoa-f6e479c6.
